count_rule.text: marks are taken in order of start time and a mark joins the cluster when its interval overlaps the cluster's interval or its centre lies within 0.05 d of the previous mark's centre (interval single-linkage clustering, aggregate.py); each reviewer counts once, with the mark nearest the cluster's median centre; a cluster whose weighted share is below 0.5 is dropped, and of two clusters on one dip only the stronger is kept

fap_tail_label: ≈ 8.9e-06 (indicative, extrapolated beyond the trials, conservative: BLS maxima are lighter-tailed than Gumbel)
fap_method: block bootstrap: the detected box is removed, the residuals are cut into 0.5-day blocks and shuffled, and BLS reruns on each of 10,000 copies; p = (k + 1)/(N + 1) with k copies reaching the observed SNR (Davison & Hinkley 1997); with k = 0 it is an upper bound. Tail: a Gumbel fit to the 10,000 null maxima, indicative, extrapolated beyond the trials, conservative (BLS maxima are lighter-tailed than Gumbel), never given below 1e-6
